description: erfana plugin hooks: project-agnostic safety, secret detection, post-compact reminders, and verification nudge. Each hook routes through dispatch.sh, which runs the .sh sibling on macOS/Linux and the .ps1 sibling on Windows, and which enforces the 5-second timeout. No hook carries a timeout key: Claude Code reads that field as seconds and Qwen Code reads it as milliseconds, so no value is correct on both. Matchers name each host's tool vocabulary; see docs/hosts.md.
